item.title: 【HD Live Performances】UPSCALE - Lady Gaga - 2025 VMA Performance 4K UPSCALE
item.description:
Lady Gaga’s 2025 VMA performance upscaled to 4K. I used the HBO rip of the performance and Topaz Video AI to upscale it to HDR. I then used the 4K enhancement of Proteus and Artemis.
